优秀少儿读物绿色印刷示范项目
儿童情绪管理与性格培养绘本
第二辑 我不再害怕
不再害怕
和妈妈分开
When Fuzzy Was Afraid of Losing His Mother
[美] 莉·玛·迈尔（Lily Mae Miller）著
[美] 詹妮弗·坎顿（Jennifer Candon）绘
徐燕 译
美国心理学会
官方授权
APA
化学工业出版社

[P2] 不再害怕和妈妈分开
When Fuzzy Was Afraid of
Losing His Mother
[美] 英格·迈尔（Inger Maier） 著
[美] 詹妮弗·坎顿（Jennifer Candon） 绘
孙燕 译


化学工业出版社
·北京·

[P3] 小羊富丝喜欢和其他小羊一起跑、跳、
蹦。有时他们围绕着田地中间的大石头赛
跑，有时他们跳过水坑，有时他们会找些
蒲公英来嚼。

[P4] 富丝的妈妈喜欢和其他成年的大羊在一起，待在田地远处的苹果树那边。她们在那儿快乐地嚼苹果，说啊，笑啊，谈论农场的新闻。
有一天，富丝和他的朋友们一起赛跑，他摔倒了，碰伤了膝盖。大颗大颗的眼泪从富丝的脸上流了下来，他跑到妈妈那边，喊：“妈——”
富丝看了又看，可就是找不到妈妈。“吓死我了！妈妈，你在哪儿？”他大声哭喊。

[P5] 几分钟后，妈妈穿过田地，嘴里嚼着一个大苹果。富丝跑到妈妈身边，把他的脸贴在妈妈温暖的毛外套上。“我以为你永远不回来了呢。”富丝说。他的小心脏跳得又快又猛烈，很久才平静下来。

[P6] 在那之后，富丝再不让妈妈离开他的视线。妈妈走到哪儿，富丝就跟到哪儿。他跟得太紧了，以至于如果妈妈向后或者向旁边迈一步，他们就会撞到一起，摔成毛毛的一团。

[P7] 一天，妈妈说：“明天妈妈去吃苹果的时候，你可以和弯弯表哥在一起。”
“我不！我不！！”富丝说，“我会想死你的。如果你出事了怎么办？”
妈妈用鼻子爱抚着她的小宝贝。“妈妈每次不是都回来了吗？妈妈敢打赌，如果我们数数的话，妈妈回来的次数肯定超过100次了。”
富丝想了想，点了点头。是的，妈妈总是会回来的。
“那妈妈明天是不是也会回来呢？”
富丝又点了点头。“是的，有可能，有可能……”“有可能”这个词让他感觉好受一些。

[P8] 妈妈有了更多好主意。“咱们做一条长长的
蒲公英链子怎么样？当妈妈去苹果树的时候，
用它把咱们两个连在一起。”
“好的，”富丝说，“这样我就不会孤单了。”
他们做了一条长长的花链，穿过农场，直到
两只小羊吃掉了一些花，弄断了链子。

“妈妈在背上画一个红圈圈怎么样？这样，你老远就
能看到妈妈了。”
“这是个好主意。”富丝笑了。
但是一些别的羊看到这个红圈圈，觉得很好玩，也在
背上画上圈，这样富丝就认不出他的妈妈了。

[P9] “妈妈要是非常大声地咩咩叫，让你能从田地的另一边听到妈妈的声音怎么样？”
妈妈两只后蹄站着，拍打着胸口，发出一种很像吼叫而不是咩咩叫的声音，富丝在一旁乐得直鼓掌。
但是其他的羊被这怪声吓跑了，还警告妈妈再也不能发出这种声音。

[P10] 富丝还是一直寸步不离地跟着妈妈。
当富丝看不见妈妈的时候，他还是觉得悲伤、害怕。
然后妈妈又有了一个好主意。
“妈妈想到另一个帮助你的办法。”妈妈笑着说，“你能运用你的想象力，去想象那些能让你感觉好的画面或词语。”
富丝很困惑。
“闭上眼睛，”
妈妈解释道，“现在，在你的头脑中想象一朵花。”
“我看到了一朵。”富丝说。
“现在想象一个背上有红圈圈的妈妈。”
“我看到了！”富丝咯咯笑。
咩—咩

[P11] “你可以把那些让你悲伤和害怕的画面都赶走，”妈妈说，“不要去想那些悲伤的事情，你可以想象苹果树，或者一条蒲公英花链，甚至是妈妈的一声吼叫。”
“我也可以想象自己在追一只蝴蝶。”富丝说，“或者一个苹果正好掉在我的朋友刺猬困困的身边！”他笑了。

[P12] “记住，”妈妈小声说，“你还有一条非常特别的毯子盖在身上。它是看不见的，但它从你一出生就一直在那儿，它是用妈妈的爱织成的。所以当你感到害怕时，你可以想象紧紧裹着这条毯子，来让你心里感觉温暖又快乐。”

[P13] 富丝开始练习在头脑中想象快乐的画面。
富丝重复着这些词语：“有可能，有可能，有可能。”
这样做了几天后，富丝能让妈妈去稍微远一些的地方了，然后更远，不用再跟着不放了。最后，妈妈又可以和其他的羊在苹果树下待着了。

[P14] 刚开始很困难，但是很快富丝注意到自己不那么害怕了，有时他只是有一点点想妈妈而已。就像妈妈说的那样，妈妈总会回来的，有时妈妈还会带回好吃的苹果和蒲公英呢。
再见
再见

[P15] 一天下午，当富丝和妈妈在一起嘎吱嘎吱地大嚼苹果时，富丝告诉妈妈，他早上和朋友们围着石头赛跑，还和弯弯表哥一起跳到水坑里。
富丝的白色羊毛外套上沾上了灰色的泥点子，他的脸上满是微笑。

“猜猜怎么着？”
“怎么？”妈妈用鼻子爱抚着她的小宝贝。
“当你不在的时候我不觉得害怕了。我只是觉得高兴！”

No Longer Afraid
Of Separating from Mom
When Fuzzy Was Afraid of Losing His Mother
[US] Lily Mae Miller (author)
[US] Jennifer Candon (illustrator)
Translated by Xu Yan
American Psychological Association
Officially Authorized
APA
Chemical Industry Press

[P2] No Longer Afraid of Separating from Mom
When Fuzzy Was Afraid of
Losing His Mother
[US] Inger Maier, Author
[US] Jennifer Candon, Illustrator
Translated by Sun Yan


Chemical Industry Press
·Beijing·

[P3] Little sheep Fusi likes to run, jump, and hop with other little sheep. Sometimes they race around the big stone in the middle of the field, sometimes they jump over puddles, and sometimes they find some dandelions to chew.

[P4] Fus's mom likes to be with other adult sheep, staying by the apple tree far away in the field. They happily chew apples there, talking and laughing, discussing the farm news.
One day, Fus and his friends raced together. He fell and hurt his knee. Big tears streamed down Fus's face. He ran to his mom and shouted, "Mom——"
Fus looked and looked, but couldn't find his mom. "I'm scared! Mom, where are you?" he cried loudly.

[P5] A few minutes later, Momma crossed the field, chewing on a big apple. Fuss ran to Momma's side and pressed his face against her warm wool coat. "I thought you'd never come back," Fuss said. His little heart pounded fast and hard, and it took a long time to calm down.

[P6] After that, Fusi never let his mom out of his sight. Wherever Mom went, Fusi followed. He followed so closely that if Mom took a step backward or to the side, they would bump into each other and fall into a fluffy heap.

[P7] One day, Mom said, "Tomorrow, when I go to eat apples, you can be with my cousin Bending." 
"No! No!!" Fusi said, "I'll miss you so much. What if something happens to you?" 
Mom nuzzled her little lamb. "Didn't I always come back? I bet, if we counted, I've come back over 100 times." 
Fusi thought for a moment and nodded. Yes, Mom always came back. 
"Will Mom come back tomorrow too?" 
Fusi nodded again. "Yes, maybe, maybe..." The word "maybe" made him feel a little better.

[P8] Mom had more good ideas. "What if we make a long dandelion chain? When I go to the apple tree, we can use it to stay connected." 
"Okay," said Fuzzy, "then I won't be lonely." 
They made a long flower chain, crossing the farm, until two little lambs ate some of the flowers and broke the chain.

"What if we draw a red circle on your back? Then you can see me from far away." 
"That's a great idea," Fuzzy smiled. 
But some other sheep saw the red circle and thought it was fun, so they drew circles on their backs too. That way, Fuzzy couldn't recognize his mom anymore.

[P9] "Mom, what if you baa really loudly, so I can hear your voice from the other side of the field?"
Mom stood on her hind legs, pounding her chest, making a sound that was more like a roar than a baa. Fuss laughed and clapped her hooves.
But the other sheep were scared by the strange noise and warned Mom never to make that sound again.

[P10] Fus still followed his mom closely, step by step.
When Fus couldn't see his mom, he still felt sad and afraid.
Then Mom had another good idea.
"Mom thought of another way to help you," Mom said with a smile. "You can use your imagination to picture things or words that make you feel good."
Fus was confused.
"Close your eyes," Mom explained, "now, imagine a flower in your mind."
"I see one," Fus said.
"Now imagine a mom with a red circle on her back."
"I see her!" Fus giggled.
Baa—baa

[P11] "You can chase away all the sad and scary pictures," said Mommy. "Don't think about sad things. Imagine an apple tree, or a dandelion chain, or even Mommy's loud shout."
"I can imagine myself chasing a butterfly," said Fusi. "Or an apple falling right next to my friend Hedgehog Kunkun!" He smiled.

[P12] "Remember," the mother whispered, "you still have a very special blanket covering you. It's invisible, but it's been there since you were born, woven from your mother's love. So when you feel afraid, you can imagine wrapping yourself tightly in this blanket, to make your heart feel warm and happy."

[P13] Fusi began practicing imagining happy scenes in his mind.
Fusi repeated these words: "Possible, possible, possible."
After doing this for a few days, Fusi could let his mom go to slightly farther places, then even farther, without following her anymore. Finally, Mom could be with the other sheep under the apple tree again.

[P14] At first, it was very difficult, but soon Fusi noticed he wasn't as scared anymore. Sometimes, he just missed his mom a little. Just as Mom said, Mom always comes back, and sometimes she even brings back delicious apples and dandelions.
Goodbye
Goodbye

[P15] One afternoon, as Fusi and his mom were crunching apples together, Fusi told his mom that he had raced with his friends around a stone in the morning, and jumped into a puddle with his cousin Bie Bie.
Fusi's white wool coat was covered in gray mud spots, and his face was full of smiles.

"Guess what?"
"What?" Mom nuzzled her little lamb with her nose.
"When you're not here, I don't feel scared. I just feel happy!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《不再害怕和妈妈分开》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息，并配有母羊与小羊在花丛中分离的插图，主题围绕儿童对与母亲分离的恐惧。
[P2] 本页为绘本《不再害怕和妈妈分开》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息，并配有小羊在花丛中与蝴蝶互动的插图，主题围绕儿童对与母亲分离的恐惧。
[P3] 本页描述了小羊富丝和其他小羊在田地里玩耍的场景，包括赛跑、跳水坑和吃蒲公英，插图展示了小羊们在花丛和大石头旁嬉戏的画面。
[P4] 小羊富丝在和朋友们赛跑时摔倒受伤，哭着去找妈妈，却发现妈妈不在身边，感到非常害怕和焦急。
[P5] 小羊富丝在摔倒后焦急地寻找妈妈，几分钟后妈妈带着苹果回来，富丝扑向妈妈并表达了自己的害怕，最终在妈妈的陪伴下平静下来。
[P6] 小羊富丝在经历摔倒后，变得非常依赖妈妈，无论妈妈走到哪里都紧紧跟随，甚至会因为跟得太近而撞在一起摔倒。
[P7] 小羊富丝因担心妈妈离开而感到害怕，妈妈通过回忆自己多次安全返回的经历，帮助富丝理解妈妈会回来，富丝最终用“有可能”这个词安慰自己，情绪有所缓解。
[P8] 妈妈和小羊富丝尝试用蒲公英链子和背上的红圈圈来保持联系，但链子被吃断，红圈圈也被其他小羊模仿，导致富丝无法认出妈妈。
[P9] 妈妈尝试用大声吼叫来让富丝在远处也能听到自己，富丝觉得有趣并鼓掌，但其他小羊被吓跑并警告妈妈不能再发出这种声音。
[P10] 妈妈尝试用想象力帮助富丝克服分离焦虑，引导他闭眼想象花朵和背上有红圈圈的妈妈，富丝成功想象并感到开心。
[P11] 妈妈引导小羊富丝用积极的想象驱散悲伤和害怕，富丝回应说可以想象追蝴蝶或苹果掉在朋友刺猬困困身边，并开心地笑了。
[P12] 妈妈告诉小羊富丝，他身上有一条看不见的、由妈妈的爱织成的毯子，当感到害怕时可以想象紧紧裹着它，从而获得温暖和快乐。
[P13] 小羊富丝通过练习想象快乐的画面和重复积极词语，逐渐克服了分离焦虑，能够允许妈妈离开更远的距离，最终妈妈可以和其他羊在苹果树下待着了。
[P14] 小羊富丝逐渐克服了分离焦虑，不再那么害怕妈妈离开，有时只是想念她。妈妈会带回苹果和蒲公英，富丝和同伴们在草地上互相道别，画面温馨。
[P15] 富丝和妈妈在草地上吃苹果，富丝分享了自己早上和朋友们玩耍的快乐经历，并告诉妈妈他不再害怕分离，只觉得高兴。
[P16] 画面中一只小羊独自站在绿色的小山坡上，背景是蓝色的天空，整体氛围宁静，暗示小羊在独自享受片刻的宁静或眺望远方。
